questions.q_en: A train crosses a 300 m tunnel in 60 s and passes a man running at 9 km/h in the opposite direction in 24 s. What is the speed of the train in km/h?
questions.solution_en:
9 km/h = 2.5 m/s

Let, train speed be v m/s and length be L m.

When train crosses tunnel of 400 m ---

(L + 300)/60 = v

L = 60v - 300 ..... (1)

When train crosses man in opposite direction ---

L = 24(v + 2.5) ..... (2)

Solving (1) and (2), we get -

60v − 300 = 24v + 60

=> 36v = 360

=> v = 10 m/s = 36 km/h

Let the points be A(4, 2), B(12, 5), C(9, 1), and D(1, -1).

The quadrilateral ABCD can be divided into triangles ABC and ACD and hence the area of the quadrilateral is the sum of the areas of the two triangles.

Area of a triangle with vertices (x1, y1), (x2, y2) and (x3, y3) is:

Hence, area of the triangle ABC with vertices A(4, 2), B(12, 5) and C(9, 1)

And area of the triangle ACD with vertices A(4, 2), C(9, 1), and D(1, -1).

Therefore, area of the quadrilateral = 11.5 + 9 = 20.5 square units

questions.q_en:
If L.C.M of 32 and 12 is L and H.C.F of 15 and 36 is H, then find
L
questions.solution_en:
According to the Question,

LCM of 32 and 12 = L

32 = 2x2x2x2x2

12 = 2x2x3

Taking common factors only once we have LCM= 2x2x2x2x2x3 = 96

L/2 = 96/2 = 48

HCF of 15 and 36 = H

15 = 3x5

36 = 2x2x3x3

Taking only common factors we have HCF = 3

H/3 = 3/3 = 1

Now, L/2 + H/3 = 48+1 = 49

questions.q_en: Two shopkeepers A and B have mixtures of rice and impurity, mixture with A and B has rice and impurity in the ratio 3: 2 and 10: 1 respectively. Both shopkeepers mix their mixture in the ratio 10: 11 and final mixture contains 55 kg more rice than impurity, then what is the total quantity of rice in final mixture?
questions.solution_en:
Part of rice in mixture with shopkeeper A = 3/5

Part of rice in mixture with shopkeeper B = 10/11

Let part of rice in mixture with shopkeeper in final mixture = X

By the rule of alligation:

[(10/11) - X]: [X - (3/5)] = 10: 11

10 - 11X = 10X - 6

16 = 21X

X = 16/21

Ratio of rice to impurity in final mixture = 16: (21 - 16) = 16: 5

Total quantity of rice in final mixture = 16/11 * 55 = 80 kg

Tap A can fill 3/4th part of a tank in 15 minutes while tap B can empty the full tank in 0.5 hours. Both the pipes were opened together for 't' minutes and then tap A was closed. The tank was then emptied by tap B in 10 minutes. What is the value of 't'?
questions.solution_en:
Time taken by tap A to fill the tank = 15 * 4/3 = 20 minutes

Time taken by tap B to empty the tank = 0.5 * 60 = 30 minutes

Since filling rate is more than emptying rate. Then,

when both the taps are opened together, part of the tank filled in t minutes = t * (1/20 - 1/30) = t/60

Now, t/60 part of the tank is emptied by pipe B in 10 minutes. Then,

10 = (t/60) * 30

t = 20

King = 4, black card = 26, The square of an odd number = 1 (32 = 9)

Hence, the required probability = 4/52 * 26/52 * 1/52

= 1/1352

questions.q_en: A solid cone of radius 28 cm and height 42 cm is melted and converted into 'n' small cubes of side 4 cm. Find the number of small cuboids.
questions.solution_en:
Volume of the cone = n * Volume of the cube

1/3 * πr2h = n * 4*4*4

1/3 * 22/7 * 28 * 28 * 42 = 64n

n = 539
